noun_definition: web refers to the online platform or interface where users can interact with chat features and access PDF attachments.
pdf refers to a file attachment in a chat that, when clicked, causes the NewDot application to crash.
newdot refers to the application that crashes when a user clicks on a PDF attachment in a chat.
Crash refers to the unexpected termination of the NewDot application when a user clicks on a PDF attachment in a chat.
